text: DSH Claude Provider（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加专用 Claude 提供方。它在模型设置中使用 Anthropic Messages 协议，可配置多个兼容服务。用户能分页发现模型、为已知型号自动补全上下文和输出容量，并为每个模型设置推理档位与自适应思考。适合在 DSH Web 中管理 Claude 模型的用户；需配置服务地址和相应凭据。

DSH Claude Provider (DSH plugin, Web client): adds an Anthropic Messages provider form. Configure compatible services, discover models with pagination, fill known-model defaults, and set reasoning and adaptive thinking per model. For DSH Web users; provide an endpoint and credentials.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · DSH Claude Provider：English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

DSH Claude Provider adds a dedicated Claude configuration interface to DeepSeek Harness. You can add multiple Claude providers, choose reasoning levels for each model, and automatically fetch model lists and fill in capacity settings and reasoning presets for common Claude models, without editing configuration files manually.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · DSH Claude Provider：Compared with the official generic custom provider form, the plugin adds a dedicated Claude entry, a per-model adaptive thinking toggle, and automatic defaults for known Claude models. DeepSeek Harness handles the saved reasoning configuration natively.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · What this plugin does：1. **Adds a dedicated Claude provider type** Open **Settings → Models → Add model provider → Claude provider** to use the dedicated Anthropic Messages form.

2. **Adds a per-model adaptive thinking toggle**

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · What this plugin does：Adds an Adaptive thinking toggle for each model alongside DSH's existing reasoning-level settings. Reasoning levels and their corresponding API parameter values remain customizable.

For Anthropic-compatible models that support adaptive thinking. When enabled, the model adjusts its thinking based on task complexity and your selected reasoning level. When disabled, it uses the thinking token limit associated with that level.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · What this plugin does：On save, the plugin writes each model's reasoning levels and adaptive thinking settings to DeepSeek Harness's native configuration.

3. **Supports paginated Anthropic model discovery**

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · What this plugin does：5. **Leaves every other provider unchanged**

Discovery, defaults, and reasoning controls are limited to Provider IDs explicitly created as **Claude Providers**. DeepSeek Harness's built-in providers and ordinary custom providers keep their original behavior, even when they use `anthropic-messages` or expose a `claude-*` model ID.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · Published package：For the browser interface, install the plugin into the Web profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider
```

Restart the corresponding DeepSeek Harness process after installation.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · From source：Clone, build, and package the repository first:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/MoFeng2223/dsh-claude-provider.git
cd dsh-claude-provider
npm install
npm run build

Install the generated package into the Web profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add ./dist/mofeng2223-dsh-claude-provider-*.tgz
```

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · Uninstall：Uninstalling the plugin does not delete official model settings or stored credentials. Existing Claude providers remain ordinary custom `anthropic-messages` providers, and their saved reasoning levels and adaptive thinking settings remain effective. The dedicated Claude add/edit interface, paginated model discovery, and automatic defaults are no longer available; the official model discovery feature remains available.
@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · DSH 0.1.7 upgrade and configuration migration：This version targets DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2.

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 插件功能：1. **增加独立的 Claude 提供方类型** 在「设置 → 模型 → 添加模型提供商」中选择「Claude 提供方」，即可打开专用的 Anthropic Messages 配置表单。

2. **增加按模型设置的自适应思考开关** 在 DSH 原有的推理等级设置中，为每个模型增加“自适应思考”开关。推理档位及对应的 API 参数值仍可自定义。 适用于支持自适应思考的 Anthropic 兼容模型。开启后，模型根据任务难度和你选择的推理等级自动调整思考量；关闭后，改用该等级对应的思考 token 数量上限。 插件会在保存时将模型的推理档位和自适应思考设置写入 DeepSeek Harness 原生配置。

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 插件功能：

3. **支持 Anthropic 模型列表分页获取** 插件通过 Anthropic 兼容的 `GET /v1/models` 接口获取模型列表，并根据接口返回的游标继续读取后续页面、合并重复模型。 4. **探测后自动填写常用 Claude 模型参数** 探测到的模型 ID 如果与插件已经记录的 Claude 模型匹配，插件会自动填写上下文窗口、最大输出长度和推理模式。用户手动添加的模型仍然可以自由编辑，不会被这项自动匹配覆盖。 5. **不影响其他提供方**

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 插件功能：模型探测、参数预填和推理档位配置只对明确创建为“Claude 提供方”的 Provider ID 生效。DeepSeek Harness 的内置提供方和普通自定义提供方会保持原有行为，即使它们同样使用 `anthropic-messages` 协议，或者包含 `claude-*` 模型 ID，也不会被插件修改。

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 安装已发布的版本：浏览器界面使用 Web Profile：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider
```

安装后需要重启对应的 DeepSeek Harness 进程。

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 从源码安装：先克隆、构建并打包项目：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/MoFeng2223/dsh-claude-provider.git
cd dsh-claude-provider
npm install
npm run build

将生成的包安装到 Web Profile：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add ./dist/mofeng2223-dsh-claude-provider-*.tgz
```

@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 卸载：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove @mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider
```

卸载插件不会删除官方模型配置或已经保存的凭据。已有的 Claude 提供方会继续作为普通的 `anthropic-messages` 自定义提供方保留，已保存的推理档位和自适应思考配置仍然有效。卸载后将不再提供 Claude 专用的添加／编辑界面、分页模型探测和参数预填；官方的模型探测功能仍然可用。
@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · DSH 0.1.7 升级与配置迁移：本版本适配 DSH 0.1.7-alpha.2。
@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 1. 尚未安装新版 DSH：先关闭 DSH，升级 DSH 和 Claude 插件，再启动 DSH。新版 DSH 首次启动时，会尝试将旧 `settings.yaml` 迁移到当前 Profile。
@mofeng2223/dsh-claude-provider README · 2. 已安装新版 DSH，但尚未运行：此时尚未触发配置迁移。先更新 Claude 插件及其他需要适配的插件，再启动 DSH。新版 DSH 首次启动时，会尝试迁移旧 Settings 配置。
